nodes.label: CLINSQL Execution Score

nodes.label: MIMIC-IV v3.1 on BigQuery Target
nodes.rationale: Final architecture decision: both Vietnamese and CLINSQL systems use BigQuery; Vietnamese migration deferred.

nodes.label: MIMIC Mini/PostgreSQL Deprecated
nodes.rationale: MIMIC Mini no longer target database; Vietnamese code kept for separate later evaluation.

nodes.label: Frozen Few-shot Development Corpus v1 (145 examples)
nodes.rationale: Excludes pilot 5, internal-check 38 and two derived-dataset examples to prevent leakage.

nodes.label: ProposedFlags Ablation Configuration
nodes.rationale: Enables independent ablation of schema_rag, multi_layer_rag, self_correction, requirement_verification, sql_validation; flags hashed into run config.

nodes.label: Strict Result Shape Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: 0/5 shape match does not mean 0/5 clinically wrong; diagnostic separated from inference and not an official score.

nodes.label: Preserve CoT Baseline Unmodified (P0)
nodes.rationale: No gold-derived projections, ICD codes or semantic refinement added to baseline, to keep source fidelity.

nodes.label: execution_errors.py Failure Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Separate infrastructure failures from model SQL failures so they are not counted as model errors.

nodes.label: n=9 integer_above_max_value Error
nodes.rationale: Provider caps n at 8, so native single n=9 request fails.

nodes.label: grouped_3x3 (SDE_GROUPED_3X3_REQUEST_ADAPTATION)
nodes.rationale: Three sequential n=3 requests preserve nine candidates and native selection but change sampling/accounting semantics.

nodes.label: RESTRICTED_EVIDENCE_EGRESS Gate
nodes.rationale: Pre-SDK decision on actual payload; blocks patient-derived or restricted dictionary data until OpenAI project data controls verified.

nodes.label: Official Evaluator Adapter (SQL Score / Execution Score)
EvidenceRouter (Qwen loopback routing)
nodes.rationale: Experimental change routing restricted evidence to local Qwen; production runner rejects it to keep GPT-5-mini-only comparison.

nodes.label: MODEL_PARAMETER_COMPATIBILITY_ADAPTATION
nodes.rationale: GPT-5-mini does not support temperature=0.1; adapter drops it, so parameter parity not EXACT.

nodes.label: Sealed 443-case Test Split
nodes.rationale: Sealed until configuration freeze to avoid test leakage.

nodes.label: BigQuery-side Column Sampling
nodes.rationale: emar.charttime sample hit 1M-row transfer limit; frequency/NULL evidence now computed in BigQuery with bounded rows.

nodes.label: total_rows-based Probe Presence
nodes.rationale: Exploration only consumes empty/nonempty feedback, so reading total_rows avoids incomplete payload transfer.
